charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Rush a target in a straight line, dealing bonus damage and knockback.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: Strike all enemies adjacent in an arc.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.description: Raise cover to Full for self and adjacent allies.

howl.name: Howl
howl.description: Rally the pack: nearby allies gain accuracy.

poison_bite.name: Poison Bite
poison_bite.description: A bite that applies poison over time.

web_shot.name: Web Shot
web_shot.description: Root a target in webbing, preventing movement.

raise_skeleton.name: Raise Skeleton
raise_skeleton.description: Raise a skeletal warrior from the earth to fight for the caster.

rally.name: Rally
rally.description: Steady allies, resisting panic and boosting resolve.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.description: Force an enemy to attack the taunter.

leap.name: Leap
leap.description: Leap over terrain to a visible tile.

stomp.name: Stomp
stomp.description: Slam the ground, damaging and knocking back adjacent foes.

fire_breath.name: Fire Breath
fire_breath.description: Breathe fire in a cone, igniting flammable tiles.

war_cry.name: War Cry
war_cry.description: A commanding shout that emboldens the warband.

curse.name: Curse
curse.description: Weaken a target, reducing its defenses.

bone_shield.name: Bone Shield
bone_shield.description: Conjure a shield of bone, granting cover.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.description: Roots erupt to hold enemies in place.

healing_totem.name: Healing Totem
healing_totem.description: Plant a totem that heals nearby allies.

hex.name: Hex
hex.description: Curse a target's aim and footing.

field_barricade.name: Field Barricade
field_barricade.description: Hammer together a barricade on a tile: half cover that blocks line of sight.

reinforced_wall.name: Reinforced Wall
reinforced_wall.description: Raise a solid wall segment: full cover, blocks line of sight, impassable.

spike_barrier.name: Spike Barrier
spike_barrier.description: Scatter caltrops and rubble: difficult ground that slows and half-covers the tile.

forge_beacon.name: Forge Beacon
forge_beacon.description: Set a forge beacon that steadies and emboldens nearby allies.

reinforce_armor.name: Reinforce Armor
reinforce_armor.description: Field-temper the armor of Torren and adjacent allies, shielding them.

battle_repairs.name: Battle Repairs
battle_repairs.description: On-the-spot repairs and first aid restoring a nearby ally.
